entries=[]
for item in raw.split(b'\0'):
 if not item:continue
 meta,path=item.decode('utf-8').split('\t',1)
 mode,kind,blob=meta.split()
 if not path.endswith('.py'):continue
 assert mode in ('100644','100755') and kind=='blob'
 entries.append({'path':path,'git_mode':mode,'blob_sha':blob,'classification':'LEGACY_PRE_TI3'})
entries.sort(key=lambda e:e['path'])
assert len({e['path'] for e in entries})==len(entries)

 p.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)

import hashlib,json,stat,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from scripts.check_repository_data import tracked_entries,audit_entries
from scripts.check_ti2_scope import audit
manifest=json.loads(Path('configs/governance/pre-ti3-code-scope.json').read_text())
all_entries=tracked_entries()
global_guard=audit_entries(all_entries)
assert global_guard['status']=='PASS'
indexed={path:mode for mode,path in all_entries}
legacy=[]
for item in manifest['entries']:
 name=item['path'];p=Path(name)
 assert indexed.get(name)==item['git_mode'],name
 for part in (p,*p.parents):assert not stat.S_ISLNK(part.lstat().st_mode)
 raw=p.read_bytes();raw.decode('utf-8')
 blob=hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(raw)).encode()+b'\0'+raw).hexdigest()
 assert blob==item['blob_sha'],name
 legacy.append((item['git_mode'],name))
relevant={path for _,path in all_entries if path.startswith(('src/','scripts/','tests/')) and path.endswith('.py')}
classified={path for _,path in legacy}
assert relevant==classified
result=audit(entries=legacy)
report={'scope':'AUTHOR_SECTION_19_LEGACY_LOCAL_GATE','baseline_git_sha':manifest['baseline_git_sha'],'global_tracked_data_guard':global_guard,'legacy_entries_count':len(legacy),'tracked_relevant_python_count':len(relevant),'unclassified_tracked_python':sorted(relevant-classified),'baseline_blob_identity':'PASS','legacy_scoped_ti2_guard':result,'experimental_opens':0,'experimental_bytes':0,'scientific_ml_runs':0,'ci_remote':'NOT_RUN','stop_on_failure':True}
p=Path('artifacts/evidence/TI3_GOV_COMPAT/legacy-scope-gate.json')
with p.open('x') as f:json.dump(report,f,indent=2,sort_keys=True);f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(report,indent=2,sort_keys=True))
raise SystemExit(0 if result['status']=='PASS' else 1)
